# vector spec stale

Refuse a generated test that no longer matches its contract.

## Usage

```text
vector spec stale <test.ts> <contract.json> [flags]
```

## Arguments

<scalar-field name="&lt;test.ts&gt;" required>

the generated test

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="&lt;contract.json&gt;" required>

the contract it came from

</scalar-field>

## Flags

<scalar-field name="--format" type="&lt;f&gt;">

text (default), markdown (a PR comment) or json

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="-h, --help">

Show this command's help, and exit 0.

</scalar-field>

## Exit codes

0 when the check passed, 1 when `vector` refused the input, 2 for bad usage or an I/O or tool failure; see [exit codes](../command-line.md#exit-codes).
